target_text:
// A token's column depends on its offset in the page. So only a whole page
        // copies as one block, and any other range goes token by token.
body:
**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: shorten**

This call-site comment restates item 5 of Note [K VNNI storage] and the k_vnni_tensor comment ('the defaulted assignment of the trivially copyable k_vnni_tensor'), and 'Every other range moves token by token (copy_token in h/tron/tensor/k_vnni.hpp)' restates the loop under it. Only the placement reason stays: why the whole-page test picks owner assignment and a partial range does not, in the style of the sibling .k and .v comments.

Proposed:
```cpp
        // A token's column depends on its offset in the page. So only a whole page
        // copies as one block, and any other range goes token by token.
```
